newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle market inactive - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle market inactive - USDA.

text.p: Trade was quiet, with no sales of slaughter steers or heifers confirmed, USDA said.
Sales confirmed on 1,900 cattle for the week to date including late Friday and the weekend, mostly previously contracted or formulated cattle.
The last established price was $66.00 per cwt on Friday.
Asking prices on Monday were $67.00-$68.00, bids $65.00-$66.00.
Confirmed - none last week - none last year - none
Wk to date - 1,900 last week - 1,000 last year - 900
